items.label: [RepBot] - Set Flair Management For Specified User
Transfer wiki page
items.description: Copy one wiki page to another

items.label: [RepBot] - Create Leaderboard
items.description: Create a custom post displaying community points

awardsRequiredToCreateNewPosts.label: Awards required to create new posts
awardsRequiredToCreateNewPosts.helpText: Amount of awarded points required before a user can make a new post. Set to 0 to disable

moderatorsExempt.label: Moderators Exempt
moderatorsExempt.helpText: Decide whether or not point awarding is required for moderators as well

messageToRestrictedUsers.label: Initial Post Restriction Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
messageToRestrictedUsers.helpText: Sent on initial post. Required even if not used. Placeholders Supported: requirement, name, commandsWithOr, commandsWithAnd, markdownGuide, subreddit, helpPage, discord
messageToRestrictedUsers.defaultValue:
***ATTENTION to OP:*** You must award at least {requirement} {name}s by replying to the successful comments. Valid command(s) are {commandsWithAnd}. Failure to do so may result in a ban.

*To hide text, write it like this: `>!Text goes here!<` = >!Text goes here!<. [Reddit Markdown Guide]({markdownGuide})*.

subsequentPostRestrictionMessage.label: Subsequent Post Restriction Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
subsequentPostRestrictionMessage.helpText: Required even if not used. Message to send users when they try to post while restricted from posting. Placeholders supported: permalink, title, name, commandsWithOr, commandsWithAnd, helpPage
subsequentPostRestrictionMessage.defaultValue: ***ATTENTION to OP:*** You must award {name}s by replying to the successful comments. Before you can create new posts, you must award **{requirement}** {name}s to users who respond on [{title}]({permalink}).

notifyOnRestrictionLifted.label: Notify on post restriction removal
notifyOnRestrictionLifted.helpText: Choose how the bot should notify users when their posting restriction is fully removed.

restrictionLiftedMessage.label: Message to send the user when their restriction is removed (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
restrictionLiftedMessage.helpText: Required even if not used. Placeholders Supported: awarder, subreddit, requirement, name, helpPage, discord
restrictionLiftedMessage.defaultValue: Your posting restriction has been removed. You now have permission to make a post again in r/{subreddit}!

postOfTheMonthFlairText.label: Flair text to use for the Post Of The Month
postOfTheMonthFlairText.helpText: Optional. Must contain text for flair setting to work if Post Of The Month is enabled

postOfTheMonthFlairTemplate.label: Flair template ID to use for the Post Of The Month
postOfTheMonthFlairTemplate.helpText: Optional. Please choose either a CSS class or flair template, not both

postOfTheMonthFlairCSSClass.label: CSS Class to use for the Post Of The Month
postOfTheMonthFlairCSSClass.helpText: Optional. Please choose either a CSS class or flair template, not both

accessControl.label: Who can award points?
accessControl.helpText: Choose who is allowed to award points

flairFormatting.label: Flair Formatting (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
flairFormatting.helpText: How the flair should be formatted. Placeholders Supported: place, total, symbol

pointTriggerWords.label: Trigger Words
pointTriggerWords.helpText: List of trigger words users can type to award points (e.g., !award, .point). Each command should be on a new line.

pointName.label: Point Name
pointName.helpText: Singular form of the name shown in award messages, like 'point', 'kudo', etc. Lowercase is recommended

pointSymbol.label: Point Symbol
pointSymbol.helpText: Optional emoji or character to show alongside point totals. Leave empty for no symbol

existingFlairHandling.label: Flair setting option
existingFlairHandling.helpText: If using a symbol, it must be set in the Point Symbol box

options.label: Set flair to new score, if flair unset or flair is numeric (With Symbol)
Set flair to new score, if flair unset or flair is numeric (Without Symbol)

baseCSSClass.label: CSS class to use for points flairs
baseCSSClass.helpText: Optional. Please choose either a CSS class or flair template, not both

baseFlairTemplate.label: Flair template ID to use for points flairs
baseFlairTemplate.helpText: Optional. Please choose either a CSS class or flair template, not both

allowUnflairedPosts.label: Allow awarding points on unflaired posts?

notifyOnUnflairedPost.label: Notify users when they try to award points on a post without flair if it's not allowed

unflairedPostMessage.label: Unflaired post message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
unflairedPostMessage.helpText: Message shown when a user tries to award points on a post without flair. Placeholders Supported: name
unflairedPostMessage.defaultValue: Points cannot be awarded on posts without flair. Please award only on flaired posts.

notifyOnPointAlreadyAwardedToUser.label: Notify on point already awarded to user
notifyOnPointAlreadyAwardedToUser.helpText: How to notify the user when they try to use the normal command on a user who has already received a point for that comment

pointAlreadyAwardedToUserMessage.label: Message to send users when they use the Normal Award Command, but the comment author has already received a point for the comment (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
pointAlreadyAwardedToUserMessage.defaultValue: {awardee} has already received a {name} for this post.

notifyOnPostAuthorAward.label: Notify on post author award
notifyOnPostAuthorAward.helpText: How to notify the user when they try to award a point to the Post Author (OP)

postAuthorAwardMessage.label: Message to send when someone tries to award the Post Author (OP)
postAuthorAwardMessage.defaultValue: The post author (OP) cannot be awarded {name}s.

notifyOnModOnlyDisallowed.label: Notify users when only moderators can award points

modOnlyDisallowedMessage.label: Mod Only Disallowed Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
modOnlyDisallowedMessage.helpText: Message shown when a user tries to award a point but only moderators can award points. Placeholders Supported: name, awarder

notifyOnModsAndPostAuthorDisallowed.label: Notify users when only moderators and the Post Author (OP) can award points

modsAndPostAuthorDisallowedMessage.label: Mods and Post Author Disallowed Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
modsAndPostAuthorDisallowedMessage.helpText: Message shown when a user tries to award a point but only moderators and the Post Author (OP) can award points. Placeholders Supported: name, awarder
modsAndPostAuthorDisallowedMessage.defaultValue: Only moderators and Post Authors (OPs) can award {name}s.

notifyOnApprovedOnlyDisallowed.label: Notify users when only moderators and approved users can award points

approvedOnlyDisallowedMessage.label: Approved Only Disallowed Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
approvedOnlyDisallowedMessage.helpText: Message shown when a user tries to award a point but only mods and approved users can award points. Placeholders Supported: name, awarder
approvedOnlyDisallowedMessage.defaultValue: Only moderators and superusers can award {name}s.

notifyOnOPOnlyDisallowed.label: Notify Users When Only OP, Approved Users, And Moderators Can Award Points

opOnlyDisallowedMessage.label: OP Only Disallowed Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
opOnlyDisallowedMessage.helpText: Message shown when a user tries to award a point but only mods, approved users, and Post Authors (OPs) can award points. Placeholders Supported: name, awarder
opOnlyDisallowedMessage.defaultValue: Only moderators, approved users, and Post Authors (OPs) can award {name}s.

notifyOnDisallowedFlair.label: Notify users when they try to award points on a post with a disallowed flair

disallowedFlairs.label: Disallowed Flairs
disallowedFlairs.helpText: Optional. Flairs where points cannot be awarded. Each flair should be on a new line

disallowedFlairMessage.label: Disallowed Flair Message
disallowedFlairMessage.helpText: Message shown when a user tries to award points on a post with a disallowed flair
disallowedFlairMessage.defaultValue: Points cannot be awarded on posts with this flair. Please choose another post.

superUsers.label: A list of trusted users other than mods who can award points
superUsers.helpText: Optional. Each username should be on a new line

modAwardCommand.label: Trusted User/Mod award command
modAwardCommand.helpText: Optional. Alternate command for mods and trusted users to award reputation points

notifyOnAutoSuperuser.label: Notify users who reach the auto trusted user threshold

autoSuperuserThreshold.label: Treat users with this many points as automatically a trusted user
autoSuperuserThreshold.helpText: If zero, only explicitly named users above will be treated as trusted users

AutoSuperuserTemplate.label: Message sent when a user reaches the trusted user threshold (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
AutoSuperuserTemplate.defaultValue:
Hello {awardee},

Now that you have reached {threshold} points you can now award points yourself, even if normal users do not have permission to. Please use the command `{command}` if you'd like to do this.

notifyOnTrustedUserAwardSuccess.label: Notify on trusted user award success

trustedUserAwardSuccessMessage.label: Trusted User Award Success Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
trustedUserAwardSuccessMessage.defaultValue: Superuser u/{awarder} gave an award! u/{awardee} now has {total}{symbol} {name}s. {awardee}'s user page is located [here]({awardeePage}). Leaderboard is located [here]({leaderboard}).

notifyOnModAwardSuccess.label: Notify on mod award success
notifyOnModAwardSuccess.helpText: How to notify users when a moderator or trusted user awards a point

modAwardCommandSuccess.label: Mod Award Success Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
modAwardCommandSuccess.defaultValue: Moderator u/{awarder} gave an award! u/{awardee} now has {total}{symbol} {name}s. {awardee}'s user page is located [here]({awardeePage}). Leaderboard is located [here]({leaderboard}).

modAwardCommandFail.label: Mod Award Fail Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
modAwardCommandFail.defaultValue: Hello {awarder}. You must be a moderator or trusted user to use {command}.

modAwardAlreadyGiven.label: Mod Award Already Given Message
modAwardAlreadyGiven.defaultValue: {awardee} has already received a mod award for this comment.

superAwarderThreshold.label: Super Awarder Threshold
superAwarderThreshold.helpText: Number of points a user must award to be considered a super awarder. Set to 0 to disable

superAwarderCSSClass.label: Super Awarder CSS Class
superAwarderCSSClass.helpText: Optional. Please choose either a CSS class or flair template, not both

superAwarderFlairTemplate.label: Super Awarder Flair Template
superAwarderFlairTemplate.helpText: Optional. Please choose either a CSS class or flair template, not both

UnrestrictedPostingMessage.label: Unrestricted Posting Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
UnrestrictedPostingMessage.defaultValue:
***ATTENTION to OP:*** Please award {name}s by replying to successful comments. Valid command(s) are {commandsWithAnd}.

Failure to do so may result in a ban.

*To hide text, write it like this: `>!Text goes here!<` = >!Text goes here!<. [Reddit Markdown Guide]({markdownGuide})*.

notifyOnSelfAward.label: Notify users when they try to award themselves

selfAwardMessage.label: Self Award Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
selfAwardMessage.helpText: Shown when someone tries to award themselves. Placeholders Supported: name, awarder
selfAwardMessage.defaultValue: Hello {awarder}, you cannot award a {name} to yourself.

notifyOnSuccess.label: Notify users when a point is awarded successfully

successMessage.label: Normal Award Success Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
successMessage.helpText: Message when a point is awarded. Placeholders Supported: awardeePage, awarderPage, awardee, awarder, symbol, total, name, leaderboard
successMessage.defaultValue: +1 {name} awarded to u/{awardee} by u/{awarder}. Total: {total}{symbol}. {awardee}'s user page is located [here]({awardeePage}). Leaderboard is located [here]({leaderboard}).

notifyUsersWhoCannotAwardPoints.label: Notify a user if they are not allowed to award points

usersWhoCantAwardPoints.label: Users Who Cannot Award Points (No u/)
usersWhoCantAwardPoints.helpText: List of usernames who cannot award points, even if they are mods or approved users. Each username should be on a new line

notifyOnBlockedUser.label: How to notify users when they are blocked from awarding points

usersWhoCannotAwardPointsMessage.label: User Cannot Award Points Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
usersWhoCannotAwardPointsMessage.defaultValue: Hello u/{awarder}, you do not have permission to award {name}s in r/{subreddit}.

notifyOnBotAward.label: Notify a user if they try to award the bot

botAwardMessage.label: Bot Award Message (All placeholders allow single or double curly braces)
botAwardMessage.helpText: Message shown when someone tries to award the bot. Placeholders Supported: name, awardee

setPostFlairOnThanks.label: Set post flair when a reputation point is awarded
setPostFlairOnThanks.helpText: This can be used to mark a question as resolved, or answered

setPostFlairOnThanksText.label: Post Flair Text
setPostFlairOnThanksText.helpText: Optional. Please enter the text to display for the post flair

setPostFlairOnThanksCSSClass.label: Post Flair CSS Class
setPostFlairOnThanksCSSClass.helpText: Optional. Please choose either a CSS class or flair template, not both

setPostFlairOnThanksTemplate.label: Post Flair Template ID
setPostFlairOnThanksTemplate.helpText: Optional. Please choose either a CSS class or flair template, not both

leaderboardSize.label: Leaderboard Size
leaderboardSize.helpText: Number of users to show on the leaderboard wiki page (1-1,000)

discordServerLink.label: Discord Server Link
discordServerLink.helpText: Optional. Link to your subreddit's discord server. A non-expiring link is recommended.

leaderboardName.label: Leaderboard Wiki Name
leaderboardName.helpText: Name of the wiki page for your subreddit's leaderboard (e.g. leaderboard). Singular form is recommended as there is only one leaderboard per subreddit

pointSystemHelpPage.label: Point System Help Page
pointSystemHelpPage.helpText: Optional. Name of the wiki page for explaining your subreddit's point system (e.g. pointsystem).

digestNewMessageEachDay.label: Create a new Modmail conversation for each summary?

upgradeNotifier.label: Upgrade notifications
upgradeNotifier.helpText: Receive a message when a new version of RepBot is released
